lines.speaker: mattie_tolliver
lines.text: Ovens are off. First time in sixty years the ovens are off at four in the morning, and it's so I can hear the alley.

lines.speaker: mattie_tolliver
lines.text: Go and stand where the drum is. They always bring the drum round the back — there's no other way to get one down that alley without being seen from the street.
